scope: Dedicated project-only Azure CPU worker; measured probes and control-plane configuration, not attestation or a penetration test

worker_network_configuration.allowed_data_destination: project blob private endpoint subnet on TCP 443
worker_network_configuration.other_outbound: Deny, subject to Azure platform exceptions

probe_limits: Input-container write returned HTTP 403; original owner-account access was denied.
Internet probe was one HTTPS endpoint; the control-plane NSG deny rules were checked separately.
Mount probes check the two expected paths, not a forensic scan of the VM.
No unrelated project was modified or granted to the worker. Role review, not exhaustive probing of unrelated resources, establishes scope.
Contributor on results includes delete permission; this is not a custom write-only role.
No teammate identities or permissions were created; no SAS links or personal credentials were shared.
Deallocation stops compute allocation; retained disks, storage and private networking can still incur charges.

independent_query.transport: initial inline envelope with four encrypted contributions; precedes the separate-silo-blob transport

known_fixed_failure: The first cloud count used a Mac-native server archive, which failed on Linux. Export with via_mlir=True fixed portability; the succeeding independent query and four-blob cloud benchmark were actually executed.
